abstract: Audits physical defense perimeters, biometric access controls, and electronic intrusion networks
system_message:
You are Perimeter Security Director (SECDIR). The Perimeter Security Director (SECDIR) oversees the evaluation of facility boundary protection mechanisms, electronic detection systems, and alarm routing architectures for cultural preservation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Infrared fence surveillance（OPTIC）
information_points.content:

SECDIR-OPTIC-AAB：For Solway Deep Salt Cavern Repository, the physical barrier surveillance map records a thermal perimeter camera density of 12 sensors/km along the outer security perimeter.
SECDIR-OPTIC-BW8：The physical barrier surveillance map for Highland Basalt Subterranean Vault shows a thermal perimeter camera density of 8 sensors/km deployed across its outer security perimeter.

information_points.title: Audits physical defense perimeters, biometric access controls, and electronic intrusion networks（DEFEN）
information_points.content:
SECDIR-DEFEN-U1G：The security operations audit of Piedmont Fortified Archive Bunker's facility boundary detection array indicates that perimeter intrusion alert integration with direct telemetry connection to regional emergency response dispatch is false.
SECDIR-DEFEN-NXP：According to the security operations audit of Highland Basalt Subterranean Vault's facility boundary detection array, perimeter intrusion alert integration with direct telemetry connection to regional emergency response dispatch is active and true.
SECDIR-DEFEN-SJ4：A security operations audit of Solway Deep Salt Cavern Repository's facility boundary detection array confirms that perimeter intrusion alert integration with direct telemetry connection to regional emergency response dispatch is true.
